name: sgr-mouse-report-is-inert
about: An SGR-1006 mouse report shares private-mode markers with the Kitty keyboard protocol. Without the patch it falls through and runs as delete-lines or SGR, corrupting the screen; the patch makes anything after CSI < or CSI = inert. scripts/wterm-0.5.0-roost.patch, csi private-marker guard.
patch: csi: return early for a '<' or '=' private marker so a mouse report is never run as another sequence
